sentences.en: Located near 400 kilometers southeast from the capital of Kiev, Dnipro is Ukraine's fourth largest city with a population of around 1 million people.
sentences.zh: 第聂伯罗位于首都基辅东南约400公里处，是乌克兰第四大城市，人口约100万。

sentences.en: Considered the major industrial centre of Ukraine, the cityscape is dotted with unsightly enterprises and manufacturing plants devoted to heavy industry,
sentences.zh: 作为乌克兰主要的工业中心，这座城市的景观中点缀着许多致力于重工业的丑陋企业和制造工厂，

sentences.en: residue from an industrial boom during the Soviet era.
sentences.zh: 这是苏联时期工业繁荣留下的残余。

sentences.en: The city was one of the most important manufacturing cities in the Soviet Union, producing many goods, from small articles like
sentences.zh: 该市曾是苏联最重要的制造业城市之一，生产各种商品，从螺丝钉和吸尘器等小物件，

sentences.en: screws and vacuum cleaners, to aircraft engine pieces and ballistic missiles.
sentences.zh: 到飞机发动机零件和弹道导弹，应有尽有。

sentences.en: The city itself is characterised by its mix of architectural styles, remnants of its rich history.
sentences.zh: 城市本身的特点是建筑风格混杂，这是其丰富历史的遗迹。

sentences.en: From Russian neoclassical structures of ornamental brick and stone, to ambitious and
sentences.zh: 从装饰性砖石结构的俄罗斯新古典主义建筑，到雄心勃勃却

sentences.zh: 未完工的苏联建筑——这象征着困扰该市至今的糟糕经济规划。

sentences.en: It's not uncommon to find very large potholes and crumbling surfaces on many of the city's smaller roads.
sentences.zh: 在许多较小的道路上，随处可见巨大的坑洼和破碎的路面。

sentences.en: Trams along the leafy main strips are often in poor technical state.
sentences.zh: 绿树成荫的主干道上的电车，技术状况往往很差。

sentences.en: A metro system opened in 1995 consists of one line with just six stations.
sentences.zh: 1995年开通的地铁系统只有一条线路，仅有六个车站。

sentences.en: Work on other stations was abandoned when the city ran out of money.
sentences.zh: 由于城市资金耗尽，其他车站的建设工作被废弃了。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Dnipro is a powerhouse of Ukraine's business and politics, the native city of many of the country's most important figures.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，第聂伯罗仍是乌克兰商业和政治的重镇，也是该国许多重要人物的故乡。

sentences.en: Tourists flood the city, visiting the various theatres, museums, parks, restaurants and beaches.
sentences.zh: 游客们涌入这座城市，参观各种剧院、博物馆、公园、餐厅和海滩。

sentences.en: By 2015, decommunisation law outlawed communist symbols within the city.
sentences.zh: 到2015年，去共产主义化法律取缔了城内的共产主义标志。

sentences.en: To comply with the law, in May 2016, the official name of the city was shortened to Dnipro.
sentences.zh: 为遵守法律，2016年5月，该市的官方名称缩短为“第聂伯罗”。

sentences.en: But prior to 2016, the city was named after Grigory Petrovsky, the communist leader of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但在2016年之前，这座城市是以乌克兰共产主义领导人格里戈里·彼得罗夫斯基的名字命名的。

sentences.en: Back then, the city was called Dnipropotrovsk.
sentences.zh: 那时，这座城市被称为第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克。

sentences.en: In Dnipropetrovsk in 1988, two baby boys were born.
sentences.zh: 1988年，在第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克，两个男婴出生了。

sentences.en: First came Viktor Soenko on March 1, and less than two months later, on April 20, Igor
sentences.zh: 首先是3月1日出生的维克多·索恩科，不到两个月后，即4月20日，伊戈尔·

sentences.en: Saprunyuk entered the world.
sentences.zh: 萨普鲁纽克来到了这个世界。

sentences.en: Although living in the industrial city, both boys were born into privilege, or at least comfortable middle class.
sentences.zh: 尽管生活在工业城市，但两个男孩都出生在优越或至少是舒适的中产阶级家庭。

sentences.en: Viktor's father was a computer engineer who worked with public prosecutions, and Igor's
sentences.zh: 维克多的父亲是一名与公诉机关合作的计算机工程师，而伊戈尔的

sentences.en: father was a pilot, who spent several years flying around the president of independent Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 父亲是一名飞行员，曾花几年时间为独立后的乌克兰总统驾驶专机。

sentences.en: Both boys had mothers who doted on them.
sentences.zh: 两个男孩的母亲都对他们宠爱有加。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor met at school and became instant friends.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多在学校相识，并立刻成为了朋友。

sentences.en: They formed a trio with another boy, Alexander Hansa, who was Victor's friend since kindergarten, and the eldest by two weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们与另一个男孩亚历山大·汉萨组成了一个三人组，亚历山大是维克多从幼儿园起的朋友，比他们大两周。

sentences.en: Alexander did not have the wealth of his friends.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大没有他朋友们那样的财富。

sentences.en: He lived in the poorer part of town where it was said rats the size of dogs roamed the buildings.
sentences.zh: 他住在城里较贫困的地区，据说那里有狗那么大的老鼠在楼房里出没。

sentences.en: He had only his mother.
sentences.zh: 他只有母亲相依为命。

sentences.en: His father died when he was a baby.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在他还是婴儿时就去世了。

sentences.en: The boys often found mischief.
sentences.zh: 男孩们经常惹是生非。

sentences.en: Their first brush with the law occurred when they were caught throwing stones at moving trains.
sentences.zh: 他们第一次触犯法律是因为被抓到向行驶中的火车投掷石块。

sentences.en: When police knocked on Victor's door and demanded compensation, his parents paid up and grilled Victor.
sentences.zh: 当警察敲开维克多的家门要求赔偿时，他的父母付了钱并严厉审问了维克多。

sentences.en: When he explained that Igor was the instigator of the incident, they forbade Victor from seeing him.
sentences.zh: 当他解释说伊戈尔是事件的煽动者时，他们禁止维克多再见他。

sentences.en: yet Victor did not obey his parents they didn't bother following through on their punishment and soon Victor was back in the company of Igor.
sentences.zh: 然而维克多并没有听从父母的话，他们也没有费心去执行惩罚，很快维克多又回到了伊戈尔身边。

sentences.en: The boys had a normal and seemingly happy upbringing although none of them liked attending school or doing their studies.
sentences.zh: 男孩们有着正常且看似幸福的成长环境，尽管他们都不喜欢上学或学习。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor had home computers and they enjoyed messing around on the internet.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多家里都有电脑，他们喜欢在网上胡闹。

sentences.en: As they grew into teens they got mobile phones, and they began to photograph and document everything they did.
sentences.zh: 随着他们长成少年，他们有了手机，开始拍摄并记录他们所做的一切。

sentences.en: Igor's mother had returned to her job as a high-ranking employee of the district state administration, and so Igor was left to entertain himself, unsupervised a lot.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔的母亲回到了地区国家行政部门担任高层员工，因此伊戈尔经常无人看管，只能自己找乐子。

sentences.en: During their time at secondary school in
sentences.zh: 在他们于第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克读中学期间，

sentences.en: Denipropetrovsk, the boys lived in fear of older and stronger students.
sentences.zh: 男孩们生活在对年长且强壮学生的恐惧中。

sentences.en: Both Victor and Igor were also frightened of heights, and they were worried that this weakness would encourage bullies.
sentences.zh: 维克多和伊戈尔都恐高，他们担心这个弱点会招致霸凌。

sentences.en: Igor searched the internet for advice on how to overcome acrophobia and read that the best method was to face such fears head on.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔在网上搜索克服恐高症的建议，读到最好的方法是正面面对恐惧。

sentences.en: This led the boys to stand on a balcony of a 14th floor apartment for hours, hanging over the railing and staring straight down at the ground.
sentences.zh: 这导致男孩们在14楼公寓的阳台上站了几个小时，悬在栏杆上直勾勾地盯着地面。

sentences.en: Eventually, their fear of heights subsided, and they deemed the face-your-fears method of getting over phobias a success.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们的恐高症消退了，他们认为这种“直面恐惧”的方法成功治愈了恐惧症。

sentences.en: With their newfound confidence, Victor, Igor and Alexander became increasingly aggressive and antisocial towards anyone they perceived as weaker than them, picking on younger,
sentences.zh: 凭借新获得的自信，维克多、伊戈尔和亚历山大对任何他们认为比自己弱小的人变得越来越具有攻击性和反社会倾向，专门欺负更年轻、

sentences.en: smaller boys.
sentences.zh: 更小的男孩。

sentences.en: As the leader of the three boys, Igor led the group into increasingly serious acts of vandalism and hooliganism.
sentences.zh: 作为三人组的领头人，伊戈尔带领团队进行了越来越严重的破坏和流氓行为。

sentences.en: He had developed a fondness for Adolf Hitler and would proudly tell everyone that he shared the Fuhrer's birthday.
sentences.zh: 他迷上了阿道夫·希特勒，并会自豪地告诉所有人他和元首是同一天生日。

sentences.en: He liked to take photos of himself with a drawn-on toothbrush-style moustache in front of swastikas he sprayed onto any surface he could find.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢在自己画上小胡子，在任何能找到的表面上喷涂纳粹标志，并以此拍照。

sentences.en: In eighth grade, Igor brutally beat another child and stole his bicycle, which he then sold to Victor.
sentences.zh: 八年级时，伊戈尔残忍地殴打了另一个孩子并偷走了他的自行车，然后卖给了维克多。

sentences.en: Although he drew the attention of police, Igor was not charged.
sentences.zh: 尽管引起了警察的注意，但伊戈尔没有受到指控。

sentences.en: It was rumoured that this was due to the intervention of his influential parents.
sentences.zh: 有传言称这是因为他有权势的父母进行了干预。

sentences.en: victor's parents again forbade him to be friends with igor but they didn't supervise the boy or

sentences.zh: 过问他出门去了哪里，所以男孩们继续见面。2002年，她的

sentences.en: teacher complained that igor and alexander had committed what was described as hooligan acts
sentences.zh: 老师投诉说伊戈尔和亚历山大对她实施了所谓的流氓行为。

sentences.en: against her rather than charges being brought the boys were separated igor was transferred to a neighbouring school and Alexander was sent to a vocational school.
sentences.zh: 男孩们没有被起诉，而是被分开了：伊戈尔被转到邻近的学校，亚历山大被送往职业学校。

sentences.en: It didn't stop the young trio from terrorising the district, but nobody would notify the police because of the influence of Igor's parents.
sentences.zh: 这并没有阻止这三个少年继续恐吓该地区，但由于伊戈尔父母的影响力，没人敢通知警察。

sentences.en: His father was seemingly able to make any unpleasant issue simply disappear.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲似乎总能让任何棘手的问题轻易消失。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor had been happy with the results of their experiment for beating their fear of heights.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多对他们克服恐高症的实验结果感到满意。

sentences.en: When Alexander admitted to them that he had a phobia of blood, Igor suggested using the same method to overcome his aversion.
sentences.zh: 当亚历山大向他们承认自己有恐血症时，伊戈尔建议用同样的方法来克服他的厌恶感。

sentences.en: Alexander would have to get up close and personal with large amounts of blood in order to beat his fear.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大必须近距离接触大量的血液才能克服恐惧。

sentences.en: There were many stray and wild animals in the forest area near Alexander's house.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大家附近的森林里有很多流浪动物和野生动物。

sentences.en: The boys took to capturing dogs and cats and slaughtering them.
sentences.zh: 男孩们开始捕捉猫狗并进行屠杀。

sentences.en: They kept this up long after Alexander overcame his blood phobia
sentences.zh: 即使在亚历山大克服了恐血症很久之后，他们依然没有停止。

sentences.en: When killing wasn't enough to satisfy, they moved on to torture
sentences.zh: 当杀戮不再能满足他们时，他们转向了折磨。

sentences.en: Igor would use the animal blood to paint swastikas on trees or fences nearby
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔会用动物的血在附近的树木或栅栏上画纳粹标志。

sentences.en: They would also take photos of each other posing with the animal carcasses
sentences.zh: 他们还会拍摄彼此与动物尸体合影的照片。

sentences.en: Collecting hundreds of gruesome pictures
sentences.zh: 收集了数百张令人毛骨悚然的照片。

sentences.en: They believed that torturing animals would help them become tougher in adulthood
sentences.zh: 他们相信折磨动物能帮助他们在成年后变得更强硬。

sentences.en: One day, they fashioned a wooden cross that they hung in the garage of one of the boys' homes.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他们做了一个木十字架，挂在其中一个男孩家的车库里。

sentences.en: They nailed a white kitten to it, crucifixion style, then took turns shooting at it with pistols loaded with rubber bullets.
sentences.zh: 他们像钉十字架一样把一只小白猫钉在上面，然后轮流用装有橡胶子弹的手枪射击它。

sentences.en: They filmed the kitten's ordeal, laughing as it died.
sentences.zh: 他们拍摄了小猫受折磨的过程，并在它死去时大笑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the adults in their lives were seemingly oblivious to what the three teenagers were getting up to when they were not at school or home.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们生活中的成年人似乎对这三个少年在不在学校或家时所做的事情一无所知。

sentences.en: Igor's parents led very busy lives with their high-powered jobs, and his father was often away for long periods flying.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔的父母工作繁忙，身居要职，他的父亲经常因飞行而长期不在家。

sentences.en: Victor's father also spent a great deal of time at work, but his mother was at home.
sentences.zh: 维克多的父亲也花大量时间工作，但他的母亲在家。

sentences.en: In 2005, when the trio were all around 17 years old, they set upon and beat up two 15-year-old boys.
sentences.zh: 2005年，当三人组都大约17岁时，他们袭击并殴打了两名15岁的男孩。

sentences.en: There's nothing to say why they chose those two targets, or if their attack was motivated by anything.
sentences.zh: 没有任何说法解释他们为什么选择这两个目标，或者他们的袭击是否出于任何动机。

sentences.en: What the records do say is that the trio pounded the smaller boys in the face until they were a bloody mess.
sentences.zh: 记录显示的是，三人组对着较小男孩的脸猛击，直到他们被打得血肉模糊。

sentences.en: The victims suffered from concussion, broken bones, and permanently disfigured faces.
sentences.zh: 受害者遭受了脑震荡、骨折，脸部永久毁容。

sentences.en: The parents of the victims tried to bring charges against Igor, Victor, and Alexander, but once again, Igor's well-connected and influential father intervened.
sentences.zh: 受害者的父母试图起诉伊戈尔、维克多和亚历山大，但伊戈尔那人脉广、有影响力的父亲再次进行了干预。

sentences.en: They got off with little more than a stern talking to by their parents.
sentences.zh: 他们只是被父母严厉训斥了一顿，便不了了之。

sentences.en: After graduating high school,
sentences.zh: 高中毕业后，

sentences.en: Victor went to the Denny Propitrov's Gyan and Steel Academy to study part-time.
sentences.zh: 维克多去了第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克矿业与钢铁学院半工半读。

sentences.en: While studying, he took on a job as a security guard.
sentences.zh: 学习期间，他找了一份保安的工作。

sentences.en: Neither of these things appealed to him nearly as much as playing around on the internet.
sentences.zh: 这两件事对他来说都远不如在网上胡闹有吸引力。

sentences.en: He and Igor had discovered and enjoyed pursuing gore websites.
sentences.zh: 他和伊戈尔发现了血腥网站，并乐此不疲。

sentences.en: The pair became obsessed with looking at photos and videos of real murders.
sentences.zh: 两人沉迷于观看真实谋杀的照片和视频。

sentences.en: They watched footage of drug cartel bosses torturing and executing, and beheadings performed
sentences.zh: 他们观看毒枭折磨和处决的录像，以及极端组织或恐怖组织进行的斩首视频，

sentences.en: by extremist or terrorist groups, until they were no longer shocked by anything the sites had to offer.
sentences.zh: 直到这些网站上的任何内容都无法再让他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: At the same time, Igor's father bought him a car as a graduation present, a green Daewoo.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，伊戈尔的父亲买了一辆绿色大宇汽车作为他的毕业礼物。

sentences.en: But Igor was not in any hurry to get a job.
sentences.zh: 但伊戈尔一点也不急着找工作。

sentences.en: To get his father off his back about finding employment, Igor declared his Daewoo to be a taxi cat and became an unlicensed taxi driver.
sentences.zh: 为了应付父亲关于找工作的唠叨，伊戈尔宣称他的大宇车是出租车，并成为了一名无证出租车司机。

sentences.en: The taxi became the perfect ruse to cover up the new favourite pastime of Igor,
sentences.zh: 这辆出租车成了掩盖伊戈尔、

sentences.en: Victor and Alexander.
sentences.zh: 维克多和亚历山大新爱好的完美幌子。

sentences.en: The boys had taken to robbing people, attacking strangers and stealing phones, wallets and jewellery.
sentences.zh: 男孩们开始抢劫路人，袭击陌生人并偷走手机、钱包和珠宝。

sentences.en: Quite often, they would pick up people in Igor's car, masquerading as a taxi.
sentences.zh: 他们经常用伊戈尔的车载人，伪装成出租车。

sentences.en: then they'd take their unsuspecting victim somewhere quiet and rob them.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会把毫无防备的受害者带到安静的地方进行抢劫。

sentences.en: Alexander had drifted between odd jobs but was unemployed for much of the time.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大在各种零工之间漂泊，但大部分时间都处于失业状态。

sentences.en: Coming from a poor household, he saw the robberies as a necessity.
sentences.zh: 出身贫寒的他认为抢劫是维持生计的必要手段。

sentences.en: Unlike Alexander, neither Igor nor Victor needed the money.
sentences.zh: 与亚历山大不同，伊戈尔和维克多并不缺钱。

sentences.en: They did it for the thrill.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做是为了寻求刺激。

sentences.en: Alexander would later say he was becoming increasingly uneasy with the activities of his friends and the recklessness with which they would attack people.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大后来表示，他对朋友们的行为以及他们袭击他人时的鲁莽感到越来越不安。

sentences.en: Fearing they might accidentally kill someone, after two armed robberies on March 1, 2007, Alexander claimed that he would not take part in them anymore.
sentences.zh: 担心他们可能会不小心杀人，在2007年3月1日发生两起武装抢劫案后，亚历山大声称他不会再参与其中了。

sentences.en: In early June 2007, Igor and Victor picked up a man and a woman in their makeshift taxi to rob them as usual.
sentences.zh: 2007年6月初，伊戈尔和维克多像往常一样，用他们临时的出租车接了一男一女，准备抢劫他们。

sentences.en: Previously, the pair would conduct their robberies at night to give them the cover of darkness, but this time they picked up their victims in daylight.
sentences.zh: 此前，两人通常在夜间进行抢劫以利用夜色掩护，但这次他们在大白天接载了受害者。

sentences.en: Worried that the couple got a good look at them and their car by which they could be identified, Igor and Victor decided that the logical step was to kill them.
sentences.zh: 担心这对夫妇看清了他们的长相和车牌，从而可能被认出来，伊戈尔和维克多决定，合乎逻辑的下一步就是杀了他们。

sentences.en: No details can be found in public records on how Igor and
sentences.zh: 在公开记录中找不到关于伊戈尔和

sentences.en: Victor carried out the deed, whether they planned it first or who did what to whom.
sentences.zh: 维克多如何实施这一罪行的细节，无论是他们是否预谋，还是谁做了什么。

sentences.en: All we know is that crossing the line from robbery to murder apparently didn't disturb them.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道，从抢劫跨越到谋杀，显然并没有让他们感到不安。

sentences.en: It excited them.
sentences.zh: 反而让他们感到兴奋。

sentences.en: On the evening of June 25, 2007, 33-year-old A.
Katerina Ryelchenko hosted an evening at her home in Denypropotrovsk.
sentences.zh: 卡捷琳娜·里尔琴科在第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克的家中举办了一场晚会。

sentences.en: In attendance was her best friend, as well as her mother, Natalia.
sentences.zh: 出席的有她最好的朋友，以及她的母亲娜塔莉亚。

sentences.en: A sociable and outgoing woman, A.
sentences.zh: A.卡捷琳娜是一位社交活跃的女性，

sentences.en: Katerina was a teacher at the local university and participated in local sports.
sentences.zh: 她是当地大学的老师，并参加当地的体育活动。

sentences.en: Over dinner, she spoke of her recent holiday to Turkey.
sentences.zh: 晚饭时，她谈到了最近去土耳其度假的事。

sentences.en: It was a good night, spent laughing, talking, and eating.
sentences.zh: 那是一个美好的夜晚，大家谈笑风生，共享美食。

sentences.en: At around 10pm, A.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点左右，A。

sentences.en: Katerina offered to walk her friend home.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜主动提出送她的朋友回家。

sentences.en: They invited A.
sentences.zh: 她们邀请了A。

sentences.en: Katerina's mother, Natalia, to accompany them, but she was too tired.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜的母亲娜塔莉亚同行，但她太累了。

sentences.en: As the girls left to make the short walk, Natalia settled into bed.
sentences.zh: 当女孩们动身走那段短路时，娜塔莉亚上床休息了。

sentences.en: After a heavy sleep,
sentences.zh: 沉睡之后，

sentences.en: Natalia woke up at around 4.30am.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉亚在凌晨4点半左右醒来。

sentences.en: A sense that something wasn't quite right compelled her to check her daughter's room.
sentences.zh: 一种不安的预感促使她去查看女儿的房间。

sentences.en: A.
sentences.zh: A。

sentences.en: Katerina's bed had not been slept in.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜的床上没有人睡过的痕迹。

sentences.en: In fact, it didn't appear as though she had come home at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她看起来根本就没回来过。

sentences.en: At 5am, Natalia left the house and went outside to search for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 凌晨5点，娜塔莉亚离开家，出门寻找女儿。

sentences.en: A short way down the path, she spotted three women huddled around something on the ground.
sentences.zh: 在小路不远处，她看到三个女人正围着地上的什么东西。

sentences.en: As Natalia approached, she realised the women were crowded around her body.
sentences.zh: 当娜塔莉亚走近时，她意识到那些女人围着的是她女儿的尸体。

sentences.en: It was her daughter.
sentences.zh: 那是她的女儿。

sentences.en: A Katerina lay in a pool of blood, her hands stiff before her face, as if she had been protecting herself from something.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜躺在血泊中，双手僵硬地挡在脸前，仿佛在保护自己免受伤害。

sentences.en: Natalia later recalled the horror.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉亚后来回忆起当时的恐怖场景。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: There was no face, only parts of it.
sentences.zh: “没有脸了，只剩下碎片。”

sentences.en: Natalia screamed to the women, That is my daughter.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉亚对着那些女人尖叫：“那是我女儿。”

sentences.en: Call the police.
sentences.zh: “快报警。”

sentences.en: And then collapsed.
sentences.zh: 然后瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: Not far away, early morning park walkers discovered the body of 45-year-old Roman Tartarevich.
sentences.zh: 不远处，清晨在公园散步的人发现了45岁的罗曼·塔塔列维奇的尸体。

sentences.en: Homeless, Roman had dozed off after a drinking binge on a park bench.
sentences.zh: 罗曼是个流浪汉，在公园长椅上喝得烂醉后睡着了。

sentences.en: His body was found in a similar way to A.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体被发现时的情况与A。

sentences.en: Katerina's.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜的情况类似。

sentences.en: Both their heads had been struck multiple times with a blunt object, to the point of being unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 他们的头部都遭到了钝器多次重击，以至于面目全非。

sentences.en: That same night, another man, Viktor Pertsev, was attacked near his housing estate.
sentences.zh: 就在当晚，另一名男子维克多·佩尔采夫在住宅区附近遇袭。

sentences.en: He too was struck in the face.
sentences.zh: 他也遭到了面部重击。

sentences.en: He was fortunate that a woman from a nearby hair salon began shouting.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，附近一家美发沙龙的女士开始大声呼救。

sentences.en: She frightened the attackers away, leaving the 58-year-old man in a pool of blood, but alive.
sentences.zh: 她吓跑了袭击者，留下这位58岁的男子倒在血泊中，但他还活着。

sentences.en: Six days later, on July 1, two more bodies were found.
sentences.zh: 六天后的7月1日，又发现了两具尸体。

sentences.en: Eugene Grishchenko and Nikolai Surchuk.
sentences.zh: 尤金·格里申科和尼古拉·苏尔丘克。

sentences.en: Little is known about their murders or the victims themselves.
sentences.zh: 关于他们的谋杀案或受害者本人，人们知之甚少。

sentences.en: They too were beaten so badly with a heavy object that their skulls split open.
sentences.zh: 他们同样被重物殴打得极其严重，头骨碎裂。

sentences.en: Five days after that, on July 6, the two young killers had their most prolific day yet.
sentences.zh: 五天后的7月6日，这两名年轻的杀手迎来了他们作案最多的一天。

sentences.en: Victor had spent the day and evening with his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 维克多白天和晚上都和女朋友在一起。

sentences.en: He then called Igor to come and pick him up.
sentences.zh: 随后他打电话叫伊戈尔来接他。

sentences.en: The two decided they would carry out a few robberies before bed to earn some extra money.
sentences.zh: 两人决定在睡觉前去抢劫几次，赚点外快。

sentences.en: Igor Nechvalod, a young man recently discharged from the army, was heading home in the early hours after a fun night out drinking and clubbing.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔·内赫瓦洛德是一名刚退伍的年轻人，在度过了一个愉快的饮酒和泡吧之夜后，正走在回家的路上。

sentences.en: He made it almost inside his house when attacked from behind.
sentences.zh: 他快走到家门口时，被人从背后袭击了。

sentences.en: Neighbours were startled by the blood-curdling screams of Yegor's mother when she discovered her son's bloodied body on the doorstep.
sentences.zh: 邻居们被叶戈尔母亲发现儿子血肉模糊的尸体时发出的凄厉尖叫声惊醒。

sentences.en: Just around the corner from where the returned servicemen lived, nighttime security guard Yelena Schramm was walking home after
sentences.zh: 就在这位退伍军人居住地拐角处，夜班保安叶莲娜·施拉姆正走在回家的路上，

sentences.en: finishing her shift early because she wasn't feeling well.
sentences.zh: 因为身体不适，她提前结束了轮班。

sentences.en: Yelena was a hard-working single mother who walked the five blocks home from work regularly.
sentences.zh: 叶莲娜是一位勤劳的单身母亲，经常步行五个街区回家。

sentences.en: She was almost home when she came upon her killers.
sentences.zh: 她快到家时遇到了杀手。

sentences.en: Yelena's mother would later say, quote,
sentences.zh: 叶莲娜的母亲后来这样说道：

sentences.en: There was not a part of her that was not destroyed.
sentences.zh: “她身上没有一处是完好的。”

sentences.en: When we arrived at the morgue, we couldn't recognise her.
sentences.zh: “当我们到达停尸房时，我们认不出她了。”

sentences.en: Tasked with the job of identifying the body,
sentences.zh: 负责辨认尸体的工作，

sentences.en: Yelena's sister could only rely on her clothes, hands, and hair.
sentences.zh: 叶莲娜的姐姐只能通过她的衣服、手和头发来辨认。

sentences.en: Then, Valentina Hansa, a mother of three, who also had been the sole carer for her disabled husband, was murdered shortly after
sentences.zh: 随后，三个孩子的母亲瓦伦蒂娜·汉萨，同时也是她残疾丈夫的唯一照料者，在叶莲娜遇害后不久也被杀害了。

sentences.en: Yelena.
sentences.zh: 叶莲娜。

sentences.en: There had now been seven similar murders in less than two weeks in an area of little more than a million people.
sentences.zh: 在不到两周的时间里，在一个仅有百万人口的地区，已经发生了七起类似的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Despite the similarities in the attacks, local police had yet to link them.
sentences.zh: 尽管袭击手法相似，但当地警方尚未将它们联系起来。

sentences.en: No warnings were issued to the residents of the industrial district that a deranged killer or killers were on the loose.
sentences.zh: 工业区的居民没有收到任何警告，不知道有一个或多个丧心病狂的杀手正在逍遥法外。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The following day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: July 7, 13-year-old Andrei Sidiuk and 14-year-old Vadim Lyaykov from Podgorodna, around 15 kilometres from Denny Propetrovsk, woke up extra early to head off to catch fresh fish as
sentences.zh: 7月7日，来自距离第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克约15公里的波德戈罗德纳的13岁少年安德烈·西迪尤克和14岁的瓦迪姆·利亚科夫，起得特别早，准备去抓些新鲜的鱼，

sentences.en: a treat for their mothers.
sentences.zh: 作为给母亲们的礼物。

sentences.en: The two young friends had gone fishing together many times and usually had a third boy with them, but their friend was not allowed out for this trip.
sentences.zh: 这两个小伙伴经常一起去钓鱼，通常还有一个男孩同行，但他们的朋友这次没被允许出门。

sentences.en: It was still dark and would be for some time.
sentences.zh: 当时天还没亮，而且还要持续一段时间。

sentences.en: His mother was afraid something might happen to him and refused to let him go fishing.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲担心会出事，拒绝让他去钓鱼。

sentences.en: So Andre and Vadim set off on their bicycles without him, carrying nothing but their fishing rods.
sentences.zh: 于是安德烈和瓦迪姆带着鱼竿，撇下他骑自行车出发了。

sentences.en: As they peddled along the familiar country road leading to the Samara River, a green-coloured taxi overtook them.
sentences.zh: 当他们沿着通往萨马拉河的熟悉乡间小路骑行时，一辆绿色的出租车超过了他们。

sentences.en: It stopped a little way ahead.
sentences.zh: 它在前方不远处停了下来。

sentences.en: The two occupants got out of the vehicle and stood in the middle of the dark road.
sentences.zh: 车上的两名乘客下了车，站在黑暗的马路中间。

sentences.en: As the teenagers approached on their bikes.
sentences.zh: 当少年们骑车靠近时。

sentences.en: The strangers turned and swung sharply at them with heavy pipes, knocking them to the ground.
sentences.zh: 陌生人转过身，用沉重的管子猛烈地挥向他们，将他们击倒在地。

sentences.en: Andre was knocked unconscious immediately, but Vadim managed to jump up and start running.
sentences.zh: 安德烈当场昏迷，但瓦迪姆设法跳起来开始逃跑。

sentences.en: Like something out of a horror movie, he heard the taxi engine roar.
sentences.zh: 就像恐怖电影里的情节一样，他听到了出租车引擎的轰鸣声。

sentences.en: As he ran, it started to bear down on him.
sentences.zh: 当他奔跑时，车子开始向他逼近。

sentences.en: Vadim's intimate knowledge of the area that had been his home all his life served him well.
sentences.zh: 瓦迪姆对他生活了一辈子的这片区域的熟悉程度帮了他大忙。

sentences.en: He veered off into the surrounding bushland where he found a place to hide.
sentences.zh: 他转向周围的灌木丛，找到了一个藏身之处。

sentences.en: The taxi slowed and passed the area where Vadim had left the road.
sentences.zh: 出租车减速并经过了瓦迪姆离开公路的地方。

sentences.en: Although petrified, he managed to stay quiet while the driver of the taxi continued to search for him.
sentences.zh: 尽管吓得要死，但他还是设法保持安静，而出租车司机继续搜寻他。

sentences.en: After a while, the car turned away and returned back from where it came.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，车子掉头回到了原来的方向。

sentences.en: Once he was sure that the attackers had gone, Vadim emerged from the shrubbery and rushed to check on his friend.
sentences.zh: 确定袭击者离开后，瓦迪姆从灌木丛中钻出来，冲过去查看他的朋友。

sentences.en: Andre lay in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 安德烈躺在血泊中。

sentences.en: His face was crushed, but he was still breathing.
sentences.zh: 他的脸被压碎了，但还在呼吸。

sentences.en: He appeared to be trying to say something, but it was impossible to make out any words.
sentences.zh: 他似乎想说什么，但根本听不清任何词句。

sentences.en: Vadim tried to stop some of the bleeding with his t-shirt and put his jacket under Andre's head to comfort him before heading to a busier road to try and get help.
sentences.zh: 瓦迪姆试图用T恤止血，并把夹克垫在安德烈头下让他舒服些，然后前往更繁忙的道路寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Car sped by the frantic, blood-spattered teenager until finally someone stopped and agreed to take the boys to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 车辆从这位惊慌失措、浑身是血的少年身边疾驰而过，直到最后有人停下来，同意带孩子们去医院。

sentences.en: Andre was pronounced dead on arrival.
sentences.zh: 安德烈在抵达医院时被宣告死亡。

sentences.en: Vadim's nightmare was only just beginning though.
sentences.zh: 然而，瓦迪姆的噩梦才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: When the police arrived at the hospital, they promptly arrested him for the murder of his friend.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达医院时，他们立即以谋杀朋友的罪名逮捕了他。

sentences.en: according to his mother they wouldn't allow him to call her before snatching him from hospital
sentences.zh: 据他母亲说，他们不让他打电话给她，就直接把他从医院带走，

sentences.en: to interrogate him back at the station when the traumatized teenager began to pass out in the
sentences.zh: 带回警局审讯。当这位受惊的少年在警车后座开始昏厥时，

sentences.en: back seat of the police vehicle a policeman poked him violently with his weapon to wake him up
sentences.zh: 一名警察用武器猛戳他，试图把他弄醒。

sentences.en: at the station they grilled vadim about the death of andre vadim maintained the story of the two
sentences.zh: 在警局，他们审问瓦迪姆关于安德烈死亡的事。瓦迪姆坚持说有两个

sentences.en: pipe-wielding, taxi-driving killers, and provided police with physical descriptions of the attackers.
sentences.zh: 挥舞着管子、开着出租车的杀手，并向警方提供了袭击者的外貌特征。

sentences.en: Two young, lean, Caucasian men with short, dark hair.
sentences.zh: 两个年轻、瘦削、白人男性，留着短黑发。

sentences.en: Unconvinced of his bizarre story, police tried to shake Vadim by threatening to keep him in a cell overnight and later send him to a youth detention centre.
sentences.zh: 警方不相信他离奇的说法，试图通过威胁要把他关在牢房里过夜，以后还要送进少管所来震慑瓦迪姆。

sentences.en: When Vadim's story didn't change, police finally contacted his mother, who arrived shortly after.
sentences.zh: 当瓦迪姆的说法没有改变时，警方终于联系了他的母亲，她不久后赶到。

sentences.en: She wasn't allowed to comfort Vadim nor accompany him during police questioning.
sentences.zh: 她不被允许安慰瓦迪姆，也不能陪同他接受警方审讯。

sentences.en: According to her, police beat her son in an attempt to get him to confess to the murder.
sentences.zh: 据她说，警察殴打她的儿子，试图让他承认谋杀。

sentences.en: Only after she threatened to go to the public prosecutor was Vadim finally released.
sentences.zh: 直到她威胁要去找检察官，瓦迪姆才终于被释放。

sentences.en: Vadim was wracked with nightmares and could not be left alone, afraid the killers would come back for him.
sentences.zh: 瓦迪姆饱受噩梦折磨，不敢独自一人，害怕杀手会回来找他。

sentences.en: Now that there was an eyewitness, police finally started looking into similar crimes in the preceding weeks, searching for a link to the murder of Andrei.
sentences.zh: 既然有了目击者，警方终于开始调查过去几周发生的类似犯罪，寻找与安德烈谋杀案的联系。

sentences.en: Armed with sketches from
sentences.zh: 根据瓦迪姆描述的素描，

sentences.en: Baddam's descriptions, police stepped up the hunt for the two young killers, bringing in detectives from Kiev.
sentences.zh: 警方加大了对两名年轻杀手的搜捕力度，并从基辅调来了侦探。

sentences.en: Although no official announcement was made, the people of Denny Propetros talked among themselves.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有发布官方公告，但第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克的民众私下里议论纷纷。

sentences.en: News spread that there were killers on the loose, preying on the weak and vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 消息传开，说有杀手在逃，专门猎杀弱势群体。

sentences.en: The locals dubbed them the Denny-Propotrovsk Maniacs.
sentences.zh: 当地人称他们为“第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克狂魔”。

sentences.en: It was clear to the townsfolk that a serial killer was carrying out the attacks, but there was no pattern among the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 镇民们很清楚，有一个连环杀手在作案，但受害者之间没有任何规律。

sentences.en: As experts pointed out, serial killers nearly always prefer a specific type of victim, but these people had nothing in common.
sentences.zh: 正如专家指出的那样，连环杀手几乎总是偏好特定类型的受害者，但这些人毫无共同点。

sentences.en: They were a range of different people, innocently going about their business, apparently attacked at random.
sentences.zh: 他们是各种各样的人，无辜地做着自己的事，显然是随机遇袭的。

sentences.en: The killers appeared to deliberately target victims who were not likely to be able to fight back.
sentences.zh: 杀手似乎故意针对那些不太可能反抗的受害者。

sentences.en: The elderly, drunks, young teenagers, or unsuspecting women who were simply in the wrong place, at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 老人、醉汉、年轻少年，或是仅仅在错误的时间出现在错误地点的毫无防备的女性。

sentences.en: Sergei Yatsenko had cheated death twice.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖·亚岑科曾两次死里逃生。

sentences.en: Around 1990, while working on a farm, he lost control of the tractor he was driving and it rolled into the river.
sentences.zh: 1990年左右，他在农场工作时，驾驶的拖拉机失控滚入河中。

sentences.en: He could have jumped out of the cabin, but he tried to save the expensive farm machinery for its owner and wound up pinned underwater.
sentences.zh: 他本可以跳出驾驶室，但他试图为主人挽救昂贵的农机，结果被困在水下。

sentences.en: By the time he was freed, Sergei was clinically dead from drowning.
sentences.zh: 当他被救出时，谢尔盖因溺水已临床死亡。

sentences.en: Rescuers managed to resuscitate him and get him to hospital, where doctors declared his survival a one-in-a-million chance.
sentences.zh: 救援人员成功将他复苏并送往医院，医生称他能活下来是百万分之一的奇迹。

sentences.en: A young father at the time, Sergei went on to devote himself to his family.
sentences.zh: 当时还是年轻父亲的谢尔盖，此后全身心投入到家庭中。

sentences.en: He had a wife Ludmila who adored him, and two sons who grew up to be fine young men, and who married young women whom Sergei came to love as if they were his own daughters.
sentences.zh: 他有一位深爱他的妻子柳德米拉，两个儿子长大成人，娶了谢尔盖视如己出的年轻女子为妻。

sentences.en: Sergei worked hard to give his family everything they needed.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖努力工作，为家人提供他们所需的一切。

sentences.en: He was a wonderful cook, a loving father, always cheerful, and met all of life's challenges with good humour.
sentences.zh: 他是一位出色的厨师，一位慈爱的父亲，总是开朗乐观，以幽默的态度面对生活中的所有挑战。

sentences.en: When a grandson came along, Sergei could not be happier.
sentences.zh: 当孙子出生时，谢尔盖感到无比幸福。

sentences.en: He took it upon himself to teach his daughter-in-law how to swaddle and bathe the baby.
sentences.zh: 他主动承担起教儿媳如何给婴儿裹襁褓和洗澡的任务。

sentences.en: Sergei couldn't get enough of caring for and playing with his grandson and taking him for long walks.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖乐于照顾和陪伴孙子，带他长途散步。

sentences.en: Sergei's life was dealt a second blow when he developed a cancerous tumour in his throat that needed emergency surgery.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖的生活遭遇了第二次打击，他喉咙里长了一个恶性肿瘤，需要紧急手术。

sentences.en: There was another life and death moment for Sergei, which he faced with strength and dignity.
sentences.zh: 这对谢尔盖来说又是生死攸关的时刻，他以坚强和尊严面对。

sentences.en: Sergei's wife Lyudmila said, quote, when the tumour was discovered, he did not complain, he did not whine, he took everything like a man.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖的妻子柳德米拉说：“肿瘤被发现时，他没有抱怨，没有哀叹，他像个男人一样承担了一切。”

sentences.en: They were both overjoyed when the operation was successful, but as a result, Sergei was left unable to speak in anything more than a whisper of a few words at a time.
sentences.zh: 手术成功时他们都欣喜若狂，但结果是，谢尔盖只能用耳语般的声音一次说几个词。

sentences.en: He lost his job, but Lyudmila said his family hurt him, and that was what mattered.
sentences.zh: 他丢了工作，但柳德米拉说家人支持他，这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: People often spoke of Sergei's kindness and gentle nature, but he was also a proud man.
sentences.zh: 人们经常谈论谢尔盖的善良和温柔，但他也是一个自尊心很强的人。

sentences.en: He looked after his unwell mother, as well as his wife, and the four dogs that he had given her home to.
sentences.zh: 他照顾生病的母亲，还有妻子，以及他收养的四只狗。

sentences.en: Unable to sit at home and feel sorry for himself, he accepted any odd job that others would offer him.
sentences.zh: 他不愿坐在家里自怨自艾，接受了别人提供给他的任何零工。

sentences.en: He was happy to take on building tasks, fixing cars, garbage collection, driving, or make deliveries on his motorbike.
sentences.zh: 他乐于承担建筑任务、修理汽车、收集垃圾、开车或骑摩托车送货。

sentences.en: According to Lyudmila, he even wove baskets and fashioned household goods.
sentences.zh: 据柳德米拉说，他甚至编织篮子和制作家居用品。

sentences.en: His voice was slowly being restored, and he could speak whole sentences, though still in a whisper.
sentences.zh: 他的声音正在慢慢恢复，虽然仍是耳语，但已经能说完整的句子了。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of July 12, 2007, 48-year-old Sergei told his wife
sentences.zh: 2007年7月12日下午，48岁的谢尔盖告诉妻子

sentences.en: Lyudmila that he was going to get some fuel for his motorbike.
sentences.zh: 柳德米拉，他要去给摩托车加点油。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he planned to go and see his grandson, just as he did every chance he could get.
sentences.zh: 之后，他计划去看看孙子，就像他每次有机会时那样。

sentences.en: Sergei set off along the quiet, wooded shortcut that led to the highway between Dnipropetrovsk and the village of Toromsky.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖沿着那条安静的林间小路出发，那是通往第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克和托罗姆斯基村之间公路的捷径。

sentences.en: Later that evening, Sergei failed to return home.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，谢尔盖没有回家。

sentences.en: Lyudmila called his mobile phone, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 柳德米拉拨打他的手机，但无人接听。

sentences.en: She then phoned her daughter-in-law, only to find out Sergei never arrived to her place as he planned.
sentences.zh: 她随后打电话给儿媳，却发现谢尔盖根本没按计划去她那里。

sentences.en: Lyudmila immediately knew something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 柳德米拉立刻意识到出事了。

sentences.en: Sergei would always let her know where he was and if he was going to be late.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖总是会让她知道他在哪里，如果会晚归也会告诉她。

sentences.en: Lyudmila was worried her husband had had an accident or fallen ill as he was inclined to overexert himself.
sentences.zh: 柳德米拉担心丈夫出了事故或生病了，因为他总是倾向于过度劳累。

sentences.en: Ukrainian regulations meant she could not file a missing persons report until
sentences.zh: 乌克兰的法规意味着她不能提交失踪人口报告，直到

sentences.en: Lily had been missing for 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 莉莉失踪满72小时。

sentences.en: She didn't sleep that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上她彻夜未眠。

sentences.en: The following day was spent posting flyers and photographs of her husband around town and asking others if they had seen him.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她花了一整天在镇上张贴丈夫的传单和照片，并询问路人是否见过他。

sentences.en: Nobody had.
sentences.zh: 没人见过。

sentences.en: Ludmilla did not give up.
sentences.zh: 柳德米拉没有放弃。

sentences.en: She continued to scour the streets, enlisting help from family and friends, until exhaustion forced her to return home.
sentences.zh: 她继续在街上搜寻，并寻求家人和朋友的帮助，直到精疲力竭才被迫回家。

sentences.en: It was two days later when
sentences.zh: 两天后，

sentences.en: Ludmilla received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 柳德米拉接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: A motorbike that matched the description of the one her missing husband had been riding was spotted lying in a bush off a nearby highway.
sentences.zh: 有人在附近公路旁的灌木丛中发现了一辆摩托车，其特征与她失踪丈夫骑的那辆相符。

sentences.en: The man who had spotted it led Ludmilla and her sons to the location.
sentences.zh: 发现摩托车的那个人带着柳德米拉和她的儿子们去了现场。

sentences.en: The family searched the area, trudging the dense woodland along the road where they eventually came across a body.
sentences.zh: 一家人在路边茂密的林地里艰难搜寻，最终发现了一具尸体。

sentences.en: They recognised it immediately from the grey, neatly pressed suit.
sentences.zh: 他们一眼就认出了那套灰色、熨烫平整的西装。

sentences.en: It was Sergei.
sentences.zh: 那是谢尔盖。

sentences.en: His face had been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 他的脸已经被毁得面目全非。

sentences.en: On July 14, two young, homeless siblings, a brother and sister, were cowering in a hut of rags and cardboard they had built, tucked away in a secluded part of Denny Propodrovsk.
sentences.zh: 7月14日，两名无家可归的年幼兄妹躲在第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克一处偏僻地带用破布和纸板搭建的小棚子里。

sentences.en: They watched as 45-year-old Natalia Mumturok drove past on her moped.
sentences.zh: 他们目睹了45岁的娜塔莉亚·穆姆图罗克骑着轻便摩托车经过。

sentences.en: bed.
sentences.zh: 床。

sentences.en: As she drove towards two young men loitering nearby, one knocked her off her moped, then dragged her into nearby bushes.
sentences.zh: 当她驶向附近徘徊的两名年轻人时，其中一人将她撞倒，随后拖进了旁边的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: When police arrived, Natalia was found in the shrub, beaten to death.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到时，发现娜塔莉亚倒在灌木丛中，已被殴打致死。

sentences.en: The two siblings were able to give police a clear description of the perpetrators, which matched those provided by young Vadim Lyaykov.
sentences.zh: 这对兄妹向警方提供了清晰的凶手特征描述，与年轻的瓦迪姆·利亚科夫提供的描述相吻合。

sentences.en: Rumours of a pair of psychopaths at large were now sweeping the city of Dnipropetrovsk.
sentences.zh: 关于两名连环杀手在逃的传言，此时正席卷整个第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克市。

sentences.en: Late night clubs and restaurants in the district and city outskirts were empty.
sentences.zh: 该地区及市郊的深夜俱乐部和餐馆空无一人。

sentences.en: Tourists stayed away from the industrial centre.
sentences.zh: 游客们远离了这个工业中心。

sentences.en: Children were kept inside.
sentences.zh: 孩子们被关在家里。

sentences.en: Detention was made all the more unbearable by the silence of the news and the absence of any official information from the police.
sentences.zh: 新闻的沉默和警方缺乏任何官方信息，让这种拘禁变得更加难以忍受。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, from July 14 to
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，从7月14日到

sentences.en: 16, two mutilated corpses were discovered in and around Denny Propotrovsk every day.
sentences.zh: 16日，第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克及其周边地区每天都有两具残缺不全的尸体被发现。

sentences.en: Each one struck in the face repeatedly with a blunt instrument, and many of them stabbed as they lay on the ground.
sentences.zh: 每一具尸体的面部都遭到钝器反复击打，许多人在倒地时还被刺伤。

sentences.en: In most cases, the mutilation rendered the victims unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，残忍的毁尸手段让受害者面目全非。

sentences.en: Denny Propotrovsk was now host to an unusual number of funerals.
sentences.zh: 第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克此时举办的葬礼数量异常之多。

sentences.en: Young Vadim Aliikov was forbidden by his mother to attend the memorial service of his friend, Andrei Sidiuk, as he was
sentences.zh: 年轻的瓦迪姆·阿利科夫被母亲禁止参加好友安德烈·西迪克的追悼会，因为他

sentences.en: still traumatised by the murder and the police then trying to blame him for it.
sentences.zh: 当时仍因谋杀案而受到创伤，且警方当时还试图将罪名嫁祸给他。

sentences.en: Perhaps if Adam had attended, he would have noticed two uninvited and familiar-looking guests.
sentences.zh: 也许如果亚当当时去了，他会注意到两个不请自来且面孔熟悉的客人。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor would attend the funerals and gravesites of their victims to take selfies.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多会参加受害者的葬礼并前往墓地自拍。

sentences.en: In some photos, they'd give the headstones the middle finger as one final act of humiliation.
sentences.zh: 在一些照片中，他们会对墓碑竖起中指，作为最后一种羞辱。

sentences.en: and disrespect.
sentences.zh: 和不敬。

sentences.en: More murders followed in such rapid succession that there is little information available about individual victims in records or newspaper reports from the time.
sentences.zh: 随后的谋杀案发生得如此频繁，以至于当时的记录或报纸报道中关于个别受害者的信息寥寥无几。

sentences.en: A task force established to find those responsible grew to encompass almost every single law enforcement officer in the region.
sentences.zh: 为了抓捕凶手而成立的专案组，规模扩大到几乎囊括了该地区所有的执法人员。

sentences.en: Officials would later say that they had over 2,000 police officers dedicated to the hunt for the two young male killers.
sentences.zh: 官员们后来表示，他们曾投入超过2000名警力专门搜捕这两名年轻的男杀手。

sentences.en: Still, this information was kept out of the newspapers, both to avoid panic and in the hope that the suspects wouldn't know the police were onto them.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这些信息还是被瞒着媒体，既是为了避免恐慌，也是希望嫌疑人不知道警方已经盯上了他们。

sentences.en: This was despite the killers knowing that they had been spotted several times and had even left some survivors.
sentences.zh: 尽管凶手们知道自己曾多次被目击，甚至还留下了一些幸存者。

sentences.en: 70-year-old Lydia Mikrenyesheva was walking her three dogs near her home when she noticed two young men nearby taking photographs.
sentences.zh: 70岁的莉迪亚·米克雷涅舍娃在自家附近遛三只狗时，注意到附近有两名年轻男子在拍照。

sentences.en: She assumed that they were looking at the nearby real estate and didn't think much of it.
sentences.zh: 她以为他们在看附近的房产，没太在意。

sentences.en: As the path wound its way through bushes, secluded from any people who might be about, she was struck from behind and fell to the ground unconscious.
sentences.zh: 当小路蜿蜒穿过灌木丛，远离可能出现的人群时，她从背后遭到袭击，昏倒在地。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor took turns kicking her in the face, hoping to dislodge what they thought were gold crayons on her teeth.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多轮流踢她的脸，试图踢掉他们以为是金牙的东西。

sentences.en: Lydia's dogs started barking loudly, spooking the pair.
sentences.zh: 莉迪亚的狗开始大声吠叫，吓跑了两人。

sentences.en: They shot the dogs with rubber bullets, killing two and injuring the other.
sentences.zh: 他们用橡胶子弹射击狗，打死了两只，打伤了另一只。

sentences.en: The commotion caused by the dogs forced the pair to run away before they killed Lydia.
sentences.zh: 狗引发的骚乱迫使两人在杀死莉迪亚之前逃离。

sentences.en: She suffered serious internal and external injuries.
sentences.zh: 她遭受了严重的内外伤。

sentences.en: Her jaw was shattered, and her face had to be rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 她的下颚粉碎，脸部不得不进行重建。

sentences.en: Knowing that the killers had robbed their victims, police distributed sketches of the wanted men and lists of stolen property to local pawn shops.
sentences.zh: 由于知道凶手抢劫了受害者，警方分发了嫌疑人的素描图和被盗财物清单给当地典当行。

sentences.en: The official story of what exactly led to the events of July 23, 2007 varies.
sentences.zh: 关于2007年7月23日事件的确切起因，官方说法各不相同。

sentences.en: What is known is that two young men visited a Denny Propetrovsk pawn shop to try and sell a mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 已知的是，两名年轻人来到第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克的一家典当行，试图出售一部手机。

sentences.en: They were offered approximately $20 US for the item if it was in working condition.
sentences.zh: 如果手机能正常工作，他们会得到大约20美元的报酬。

sentences.en: To test the device, the shop clerk pressed the power button.
sentences.zh: 为了测试设备，店员按下了电源键。

sentences.en: Sure enough, the screen flickered to life.
sentences.zh: 果然，屏幕亮了起来。

sentences.en: As soon as the mobile phone was turned on, it released a signal that was immediately intercepted by police.
sentences.zh: 手机一开机，就发出了信号，立即被警方截获。

sentences.en: The phone belonged to one of the victiMs. Police stormed the pawn shop and confronted the killers,
sentences.zh: 这部手机属于受害者之一。警方突袭了典当行并抓获了凶手，

sentences.en: Viktor Sayenko and Igor Suprunyuk.
sentences.zh: 维克多·萨延科和伊戈尔·苏普鲁纽克。

sentences.zh: 据负责收集衣物的调查员称，伊戈尔和维克多的物品中没有一件是没有血迹的。

sentences.en: Their jeans, sneakers and jackets were all soiled in varying intensity of red and brown.

sentences.zh: 尽管发生了一连串以同样方式实施的残忍谋杀案，但第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克市既没有警告市民，也没有实施宵禁。

sentences.en: Although some individual crimes made the local papers, there had been no major news stories of people being randomly attacked, murdered and mutilated by serial killers.
sentences.zh: 虽然一些个别案件登上了当地报纸，但并没有关于人们被连环杀手随机袭击、谋杀和残害的重大新闻报道。

sentences.en: Law enforcement and media alike tried to establish a motive for the killings.

sentences.en: He was known to regularly hang out with Igor and Victor.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他经常和伊戈尔、维克多混在一起。

sentences.en: Neighbours recalled many times spotting the green daewoo pulling up outside Kozlov's house.
sentences.zh: 邻居们回忆说，多次看到那辆绿色大宇轿车停在科兹洛夫家门外。

sentences.en: It would honk for him and Kozlov would emerge from the house and climb into the vehicle before it headed off.
sentences.zh: 车会按喇叭叫他，科兹洛夫就会从屋里出来，上车后离开。

sentences.en: Kozlov was arrested.
sentences.zh: 科兹洛夫被捕了。

sentences.en: Some reports say for the murders, others for hooliganism.
sentences.zh: 一些报道说是因谋杀罪，另一些说是因流氓罪。

sentences.en: He too was the son of a powerful and well-connected father with ties to officials.
sentences.zh: 他也是一位权势显赫、与官员有联系的父亲的儿子。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, he admitted to having knowledge of the crimes, having seen video and pictures taken by the killers and hearing them brag about robbing and killing.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，他承认自己知晓这些罪行，看过凶手拍摄的视频和照片，并听过他们吹嘘抢劫和杀人。

sentences.en: The killers urged Kozlov to join them, saying there was the prospect of making a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 凶手们怂恿科兹洛夫加入他们，说有赚大钱的前景。

sentences.en: They showed him their expensive computer equipment, which they claimed was rewards of their crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们向他展示了昂贵的电脑设备，声称那是他们犯罪的战利品。

sentences.en: People thought that it was quite likely that Kozlov was involved in at least one murder, but the combination of his willingness to talk and his rich and well-connected

sentences.en: Alexander's mother had no influence or contacts, but Igor and Victor's parents threw all of their resources and connections into setting their sons free.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大的母亲没有任何影响力和人脉，但伊戈尔和维克多的父母投入了所有的资源和关系来让他们的儿子获释。

sentences.en: They maintained firmly that their sons were innocent of all crimes, and were fall guys for the true criminals whose power and wealth provided them with immunity.
sentences.zh: 他们坚定地主张儿子是无辜的，是真正罪犯的替罪羊，而那些罪犯凭借权力和财富获得了豁免权。

sentences.en: Their public support was met with considerable scepticism.
sentences.zh: 他们的公开支持遭到了相当大的怀疑。

sentences.en: Alexander's mother told reporters that there had been a mistake in arresting her son.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大的母亲告诉记者，逮捕她儿子是一个错误。

sentences.en: Ironically, she said, quote, he's a kind boy.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，她说：“他是个善良的孩子。”

sentences.en: He couldn't hurt a cat, let alone a person.
sentences.zh: “他连猫都伤害不了，更别说人了。”

sentences.en: Victor's father told the press, I don't know why my son is admitting to these charges.
sentences.zh: 维克多的父亲对媒体说：“我不知道我儿子为什么要承认这些指控。”

sentences.en: He's an ordinary boy.
sentences.zh: “他是个普通的孩子。”

sentences.en: I think that he must have been intimidated by someone.
sentences.zh: “我想他一定是受到了某人的恐吓。”

sentences.en: These charges have been fabricated.
sentences.zh: “这些指控都是捏造的。”

sentences.zh: 伊戈尔尤其自信，认为他的父母会解决这个问题，就像他们在他一生中遇到的每一次麻烦中为他保释一样。

sentences.zh: 并与受害者合影。从一段虐待小猫的加长视频，到在受害者葬礼上拍摄的自拍，应有尽有，还有他们

sentences.zh: 维克多急于逃离犯罪现场，但伊戈尔坚持要两人回去拍张自拍。

sentences.en: Once he finished washing, they returned to the bloodied remains of Sergei.
sentences.zh: 洗完后，他们回到了谢尔盖血肉模糊的尸体旁。

sentences.en: In a final act of indignity to the proud family man, Igor and Victor stood over him and photographed themselves performing the Nazi salute.
sentences.zh: 为了对这位顾家的好男人进行最后的羞辱，伊戈尔和维克多站在他上方，拍下了他们行纳粹礼的照片。

sentences.en: Victor Soenko's father insisted that the photographs and footage of his son and friend killing Sergei and others were faked.
sentences.zh: 维克多·萨延科的父亲坚称，他儿子和朋友杀害谢尔盖及其他人的照片和视频都是伪造的。

sentences.en: He told reporters that when police raided his house, they found perfectly innocent pictures
sentences.zh: 他告诉记者，警察搜查他家时，发现的都是完全无辜的照片

sentences.en: and videos of Victor with his friend Igor in the woods, and that someone who wanted to frame them made up photos and videos using special effects.
sentences.zh: 和维克多与朋友伊戈尔在树林里的视频，并称有人想陷害他们，利用特效制作了这些照片和视频。

sentences.en: Experts agreed that faking all footage found would require a Hollywood-level special effects team and a year of editing.
sentences.zh: 专家们一致认为，伪造所有发现的视频需要好莱坞级别的特效团队和一年的剪辑时间。

sentences.en: Somehow, eight minutes of footage showing the final brutal moments of Sergei Yatsenko's life made its way from the evidence room to the internet.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，那段记录了谢尔盖·亚岑科生命最后残忍时刻的八分钟视频，从证据室流传到了互联网上。

sentences.en: For those who could stomach watching it, there was no doubt that the giggling psychopath featured in the video was Igor
sentences.zh: 对于那些能忍受观看的人来说，毫无疑问，视频中那个咯咯笑着的变态就是伊戈尔·

sentences.en: Saprunyuk and his friend Viktor Sayenko was behind the camera.
sentences.zh: 苏普鲁纽克，而他的朋友维克多·萨延科则在摄像机后面。

sentences.en: With the release of the video online, another theory began to circulate.
sentences.zh: 随着视频在网上发布，另一种理论开始流传。

sentences.en: Local media reported the killers had a plan to get rich by selling their murder videos to an underground snuff ring.
sentences.zh: 当地媒体报道称，杀手们有一个发财计划，就是把他们的谋杀视频卖给地下虐杀视频团伙。

sentences.en: Snuff is a genre of film depicting the very real killing of a human being.
sentences.zh: 虐杀视频是一种描绘真实杀人过程的电影类型。

sentences.en: The girlfriend of one of the boys reported that they planned to make 40 separate videos of murders.
sentences.zh: 其中一名男孩的女友报告说，他们计划制作40部谋杀视频。

sentences.en: This was corroborated by a former classmate who claimed he heard Igor was in contact with a rich foreign website operator
sentences.zh: 这一点得到了前同学的证实，他声称听说伊戈尔与一名富有的外国网站经营者有联系，

sentences.en: who ordered 40 snuff videos and would pay lots of money once they were made.
sentences.zh: 对方订购了40部虐杀视频，并承诺在制作完成后支付巨额报酬。

sentences.en: Journalists tried to verify the existence of this snuff network.
sentences.zh: 记者们试图核实这个虐杀视频网络的存在。

sentences.en: One news crew claimed to find a site with the help of a Russian hacker that contained hundreds of murder videos, many of them made in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 一个新闻组声称在一名俄罗斯黑客的帮助下找到了一个网站，里面包含数百部谋杀视频，其中许多是在乌克兰制作的。

sentences.en: But their efforts led nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但他们的努力一无所获。

sentences.en: The story was likely a fantasy woven around the video of Sergei's murder, which had reached viral proportions on shock and gore websites.
sentences.zh: 这个故事很可能是围绕谢尔盖谋杀案视频编造的幻想，该视频在猎奇网站上已经疯传。

sentences.en: It should be noted that someone with access to court records leaked the footage, not the killers themselves.
sentences.zh: 需要指出的是，是某个能接触到法庭记录的人泄露了视频，而不是杀手本人。

sentences.en: Shortly after their arrest, the three suspects received psychiatric evaluations.
sentences.zh: 被捕后不久，三名嫌疑人接受了精神评估。

sentences.en: All were deemed sane and fit to stand trial.
sentences.zh: 所有人都被认定神志清醒，适合接受审判。

sentences.en: Nevertheless,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，

sentences.en: Igor's lawyer tried to mount an insanity defence and insisted that his client should be treated, not punished.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔的律师试图进行精神错乱辩护，坚持认为他的当事人应该接受治疗，而不是惩罚。

sentences.en: Igor's paternal grandmother had schizophrenia and his lawyer argued that Igor inherited the condition.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔的祖母患有精神分裂症，他的律师辩称伊戈尔遗传了这种疾病。

sentences.en: Igor pleaded not guilty by reason of insanity.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔以精神错乱为由拒不认罪。

sentences.en: His lawyer disputed the psychiatric evaluation that declared Igor was sane, saying that the
sentences.zh: 他的律师质疑宣布伊戈尔神志清醒的精神评估，称这些罪行的

sentences.en: notoriety of the crimes meant the defendants could not get fair treatment and the results were rushed and biased.
sentences.zh: 臭名昭著意味着被告无法得到公正对待，评估结果是仓促且带有偏见的。

sentences.en: The trial of Igor Suprunyuk, Victor Sayenko and Alexander Hansa began in June 2008.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔·苏普鲁纽克、维克多·萨延科和亚历山大·汉扎的审判于2008年6月开始。

sentences.en: It was delayed after the first day when Igor's lawyer quit, citing his own health probleMs. Then in another twist, Victor's parents fired his lawyer
sentences.zh: 第一天之后，伊戈尔的律师以自身健康问题为由退出，审判因此延期。随后又出现了一个转折，维克多的父母解雇了他的律师，

sentences.en: and his own father took on the defence.
sentences.zh: 由他自己的父亲接手辩护。

sentences.en: Victor's lawyer was happy to be dismissed, saying that his client's story had changed and he felt he could no longer provide him an adequate defence.
sentences.zh: 维克多的律师很高兴被解雇，他说他当事人的说法变了，他觉得无法再为他提供充分的辩护。

sentences.en: Victor, under the guidance of his father, recanted the confession he had made in the police station, saying it had been forced out of him through the use of violence and coercion.
sentences.zh: 在父亲的指导下，维克多推翻了他在警察局所做的供词，称那是通过暴力和胁迫手段逼出来的。

sentences.en: The case was adjourned until the new defence teams could get acquainted with the case file.
sentences.zh: 案件休庭，直到新的辩护团队熟悉案卷。

sentences.en: There were whispers that Victor's father explored other methods of freeing his son, including pressuring at least one of the surviving victims not to testify.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，维克多的父亲探索了其他解救儿子的方法，包括向至少一名幸存受害者施压，要求其不要作证。

sentences.en: The trial recommenced in early July.
sentences.zh: 审判于7月初重新开始。

sentences.en: The three accused had to be transported to and from the courtroom wearing body armour, as there was a very real fear they would be attacked by
sentences.zh: 三名被告往返法庭时必须穿戴防弹衣，因为人们非常担心他们会遭到

sentences.en: victim's families or the general public.
sentences.zh: 受害者家属或公众的袭击。

sentences.en: Inside a court, they were put into a cage from where they observed the proceedings behind bars.
sentences.zh: 在法庭内，他们被关进一个笼子里，在铁栏杆后面观察庭审过程。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor were allowed access to their parents who formed part of their defence teams, but Alexander's mother was denied any contact with her son.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多可以接触作为辩护团队成员的父母，但亚历山大的母亲被禁止与儿子有任何接触。

sentences.en: Ten lawyers represented 29 family members of victims eligible for compensation from the crimes.
sentences.zh: 十名律师代表了29名有资格获得犯罪赔偿的受害者家属。

sentences.en: The prosecution's evidence included eyewitness testimony, the many items belonging to the victims recovered from the homes of the defendants, and DNA evidence that confirmed
sentences.zh: 检方的证据包括目击者证词、从被告家中搜出的许多属于受害者的物品，以及证实

sentences.en: with over 99% accuracy the involvement of the accused in the murders.
sentences.zh: 被告参与谋杀的准确率超过99%的DNA证据。

sentences.en: But the most compelling evidence was the photographs and videos produced by the suspects themselves.
sentences.zh: 但最有力的证据是嫌疑人自己制作的照片和视频。

sentences.en: The court had a psychologist on standby when these exhibits were presented, and the counsellor was put to good use.
sentences.zh: 当这些证据被展示时，法庭安排了一名心理学家待命，这位咨询师确实发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Several people ran from the court distraught after observing the disturbing content.
sentences.zh: 几个人在看到令人不安的内容后，心烦意乱地跑出了法庭。

sentences.en: The killers gazed calmly from behind the bars to the TV screen.
sentences.zh: 杀手们平静地从铁栏杆后盯着电视屏幕。

sentences.en: Occasionally, they exchanged glances and smirks.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，他们会交换眼神并露出冷笑。

sentences.en: When it came time for them to be questioned about the videos, They denied they were involved.
sentences.zh: 当轮到他们就视频接受质询时，他们否认自己参与其中。

sentences.en: In an outrageous claim, they said they didn't recognise anyone in the footage, despite the many shots in which they appeared close up to the camera.
sentences.zh: 他们提出了一个荒谬的主张，称不认识视频中的任何人，尽管视频中多次出现他们靠近镜头的特写镜头。

sentences.en: The judge didn't appreciate the court being played for a fool and responded,
sentences.zh: 法官对法庭被当成傻子耍感到不满，回应道：

sentences.en: you are not blind.
sentences.zh: 你们又不是瞎子。

sentences.en: The defence team for Igor and Victor tried every tactic, from having the photos and videos thrown out of evidence due to them being obtained by an
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多的辩护团队尝试了各种策略，从以非法搜查为由要求将照片和视频排除在证据之外，

sentences.en: improper search, to presenting a conspiracy cover-up that protected the real culprits, who they said were rich and famous.
sentences.zh: 到提出一个掩盖真相的阴谋论，声称真正的罪犯受到了保护，因为他们富有且出名。

sentences.en: They also argued that the confessions had been obtained through torture, although only Alexander had shown any signs of being beaten.
sentences.zh: 他们还辩称供词是通过酷刑获得的，尽管只有亚历山大表现出被殴打的迹象。

sentences.en: When it came their turn to testify, the killers turned on each other.
sentences.zh: 轮到他们作证时，杀手们开始互相攻击。

sentences.en: According to Victor's father, Victor was himself a victim, terrified of the psychotic Igor who had forced him into participating in the slaughter.
sentences.zh: 据维克多的父亲称，维克多本人也是受害者，他害怕精神病态的伊戈尔，是被迫参与屠杀的。

sentences.en: He claimed a sort of Stockholm syndrome and an ever-growing psychological dependence on Igor arising from the fear the enigmatic younger boy had instilled in him.
sentences.zh: 他声称这是一种斯德哥尔摩综合征，由于那个神秘的年轻男孩灌输的恐惧，他对伊戈尔产生了日益增长的心理依赖。

sentences.en: Victor claimed Igor had made both direct and implied threats of violence and that he had convinced him that he could ensure all of the blame fell upon Victor should they ever
sentences.zh: 维克多声称伊戈尔曾直接和暗示地发出暴力威胁，并让他相信，如果他们被抓住，他能确保所有的罪责都落在维克多身上。

sentences.en: be caught.
sentences.zh: （接上句）

sentences.en: Alexander's defence was that he was only involved in a single robbery prior to the murderous spree.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大的辩护理由是他只参与了谋杀狂潮前的一起抢劫案。

sentences.en: He pled guilty to the robbery and claimed he had no idea what Igor and Victor were capable of, and if he had known, he would not have gone near them, even at gunpoint.
sentences.zh: 他承认了抢劫罪，并声称他根本不知道伊戈尔和维克多能做出这种事，如果他早知道，即使拿枪指着他，他也不会靠近他们。

sentences.en: As for the property belonging to the victims that was found at Alexander's house, it was accepted that Igor and Victor gifted him these items and that he wasn't actually present
sentences.zh: 至于在亚历山大家中发现的属于受害者的财物，他辩称那是伊戈尔和维克多送给他的礼物，他本人并没有在

sentences.en: at the murders.
sentences.zh: 谋杀现场。

sentences.en: Igor, meanwhile, was generally silent throughout the trial,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，伊戈尔在整个审判过程中基本保持沉默，

sentences.en: although he seemed to enjoy the replaying of his exploits on video.
sentences.zh: 尽管他似乎很享受在视频中重温自己的所作所为。

sentences.en: His mother formed part of the defence team, and families of the victims would later say they felt intimidated by her cold, unwavering stare and complete lack of sympathy.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是辩护团队的一员，受害者家属后来表示，她那冰冷、坚定的凝视和完全缺乏同情心的态度让他们感到恐惧。

sentences.en: The one thing the prosecution still could not answer was the question of motive.
sentences.zh: 检方仍然无法回答的一个问题是动机。

sentences.en: The lack of motive, coupled with the extreme cruelty made this case unique.
sentences.zh: 动机的缺失，加上极端的残忍，使这起案件独一无二。

sentences.en: They accepted that profit from robbery was not the main purpose, since most of their victims had little to steal.
sentences.zh: 他们承认抢劫获利并非主要目的，因为大多数受害者身上几乎没什么可偷的。

sentences.en: The rumours of creation of videos for sale to the snuff market were not addressed at the trial at all.
sentences.zh: 关于制作视频卖给虐杀市场的传闻在审判中根本没有被提及。

sentences.en: Eventually, the prosecution settled on the unthinkable.
sentences.zh: 最终，检方得出了一个令人难以置信的结论。

sentences.en: Igor and Victor tortured and killed people, simply for the thrill, and filmed their exploits to have mementos to look back on and enjoy in their old age.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔和维克多折磨并杀害他人，纯粹是为了寻求刺激，并拍下他们的暴行，作为日后年老时回顾和享受的纪念品。

sentences.en: On February 11, 2009, the court found Igor Sepunyuk and Victor Sayenko guilty of all charges.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月11日，法庭裁定伊戈尔·苏普鲁纽克和维克多·萨延科所有指控罪名成立。

sentences.en: Igor was found guilty of 21 murders, and Victor was found guilty of 18.
sentences.zh: 伊戈尔被判犯有21起谋杀罪，维克多被判犯有18起。

sentences.en: They both received life sentences, which they immediately appealed, but which were upheld later that year by the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 两人均被判处终身监禁，他们立即提出上诉，但同年晚些时候被最高法院驳回。

sentences.en: Alexander Hansa was found guilty of robbery and sentenced to nine years in prison.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·汉扎被判犯有抢劫罪，入狱九年。

sentences.en: He did not appeal.
sentences.zh: 他没有上诉。

sentences.en: Nobody could believe that the parents of the convicted had truly been blissfully unaware of what Igor and Victor were getting up to.
sentences.zh: 没人相信罪犯的父母真的对伊戈尔和维克多的所作所为一无所知。

sentences.en: They were accused of turning a blind eye to their misdeeds and bloodstained clothes and their suspicious collection of electronics and jewelry.
sentences.zh: 他们被指控对孩子的恶行、血迹斑斑的衣服以及可疑的电子产品和珠宝收藏视而不见。

sentences.en: When Yelena Schramm's mother accosted Igor's mother, she reportedly looked her right in the eye and said coldly, maybe your daughter was just destined to die.
sentences.zh: 当耶琳娜·施拉姆的母亲质问伊戈尔的母亲时，据报道，她直视对方的眼睛冷冷地说，也许你的女儿注定要死。

sentences.en: The mother of returned servicemen Igor Nechvalod said, quote,
sentences.zh: 退伍军人伊戈尔·内赫瓦洛德的母亲说，引用如下：

sentences.en: No job can be an excuse for mental deafness to your child.
sentences.zh: 任何工作都不能成为对孩子精神麻木的借口。

sentences.en: How could you not feel the changes in the moods of the children, not see the deformation of their interests, not pay attention to the completely blood-stained clothes.
sentences.zh: 你怎么可能感觉不到孩子情绪的变化，看不到他们兴趣的扭曲，不注意那完全沾满血迹的衣服。

sentences.en: How did you not look under the bed where the murder tools were stored, and ignore other people's things suddenly appearing in your house, or the appearance of guns and bullets?
sentences.zh: 你怎么会不去看看床底下藏着的凶器，忽略家里突然出现的别人的东西，或者枪支和子弹的出现？

sentences.en: Natalia Ilchenko lived so close to the site of her daughter's murder that she had to pass by it almost every day.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉亚·伊尔琴科住的地方离她女儿被谋杀的地点很近，她几乎每天都要经过那里。

sentences.en: Each time she would say a prayer for her daughter, a Katarina.
sentences.zh: 每次她都会为她的女儿卡塔琳娜祈祷。

sentences.en: She later told reporters, quote, you can't even call them animals because animals kill in self-defense by instinct or when they sense danger.
sentences.zh: 她后来告诉记者，引用如下：你甚至不能称他们为动物，因为动物杀戮是为了自卫、本能或感觉到危险时。

sentences.en: They did it just for pleasure.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做纯粹是为了快乐。

sentences.en: They killed people for fun.
sentences.zh: 他们杀人是为了好玩。
